object.description: Define an optional date attribute. Set it on an object to 2026-04-25 and validate, then to 25/04/2026 and validate; set it to 2026-12-31 and validate, then to not-a-date and validate. Expected: no ATTR_BAD_DATE for 2026-04-25 or 2026-12-31; ATTR_BAD_DATE for 25/04/2026 and for not-a-date.
